newsitem.title: USA: Noxso says Olin takes it to bankruptcy court.
newsitem.headline: Noxso says Olin takes it to bankruptcy court.

text.p: Noxso Corp said Friday that an involuntary bankruptcy petition has been filed against it by Olin Corp and two other creditors.
In a brief announcement, Noxso said it is in the process of evaluating the petition and intends to contest it vigorously.
It said the petition was filed in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Eastern District of Tennessee.
Joel Walker, an attorney for Noxso, said, "We are in the process of looking into this to determine what course of action to take.
On February 2, Noxso said Olin had declared Noxso's $1.8 million note, which fell due January 31, in default.

It said Olin notified it of plans to end its supply agreement and planned to take title to a facility that Noxso built at at Olin's Charleston, Tenn., plant. Olin was to lease the facility and buy elemental sulfur from Noxso for 10 years for $3.2 million a year.
On February 4, Noxso said it had won a preliminary injunction barring Oliln from terminating the supply agremeent or taking title to the facility.
